episodes.synopsis: Yozora and Kodoka are loners at school. In order to make friends with other misfits, they start the Neighbors Club. Soon, a third member joins the club: Sena, a popular girl who annoys Yozora to no end.
episodes.title: We Can't Make Any Friends

episodes.synopsis: Yozora, Kodaka, and Sena try to bond over some co-op video game action. Unfortunately, the girls are way better at bashing each other than working as a team.
episodes.title: There's No God in the Electric World

episodes.synopsis: Kodaka tries to give Sena a swimming lesson, but some obnoxious guys hanging out by the pool make the situation even more uncomfortable than it already is. Luckily, Kodaka’s got Sena’s back.
episodes.title: There Are No Flags at the Swimming Pool

episodes.synopsis: The Club gets a couple of new freshmen members: Yukimura, who’s been following Kodaka around to learn some lessons in manliness, and Rika, an awkward young scientist.
episodes.title: Underclassmen Don't Hold Back

episodes.synopsis: Rika gets the group to play a new RPG. Of course, the gang’s manic dynamic is as much a problem in the virtual world as it is in the real one. Later, Kodaka must deal with a surprising new Club member.
episodes.title: This Time, the SAGA is a Serious Battle

episodes.synopsis: When the Neighbors Club heads out to sing some karaoke, the whole group ends up divided between multiple rooms. Later, Yozora gets jealous when she hears that Sena’s dad wants to meet Kodaka.
episodes.title: There Aren't Many Customers at the Karaoke Box

episodes.synopsis: With summer break approaching, the gang decides to use their cell phones to keep in touch. Sena decides to get the same model as Kodaka's - a choice which drives Yozora totally insane.
episodes.title: My Cell Phone Doesn't Get Many Calls

episodes.synopsis: Kobato’s burning up, thanks to a busted A/C. Inspired by her favorite anime, she decides to wear more season-appropriate attire. Later, the Neighbors Club heads to the pool to cool off.
episodes.title: School Swimsuits Don't Appear

episodes.synopsis: Sena takes Kodaka and Kobato to meet her father, Pegasus. They decide to spend the night - and lots and lots of awkward situations ensue.
episodes.title: The President's Recollections are Painful

episodes.synopsis: The gang heads to Sena’s summer home, where they spend hours romping on the beach. Later, the group settles in for some ghost stories. Unfortunately, after the chilling tales, everyone’s too scared to go to the bathroom alone.
episodes.title: No One Sleeps at Camp

episodes.synopsis: It’s festival time! Kodoka talks to Sena about hair dye, and Yozora’s hair becomes a casualty of a fireworks display!
episodes.title: Girls Are Super-Cute in Yukatas

episodes.synopsis: The origins of the Neighbors Club – and a few gender-bending secrets – are finally revealed! What on Earth will happen next!?
episodes.title: We Don't Have Many Friends
